name: dialect
description: Manual-only controlled-language modes. Constrains the vocabulary, sentence shape, evidence, and order of what Claude writes to a published rule set, for one target or for the rest of the session. Ships /ste (ASD-STE100), /plain (ISO 24495-1 plain language), /ubiquitous (ubiquitous language), /calibrated (ICD 203 analytic standards), /normative (RFC 2119 keywords), /ears (Easy Approach to Requirements Syntax), /bluf (bottom line up front), /pyramid (Minto), /sbar (clinical handoff), /comments (Conventional Comments), and /diataxis (four documentation modes).
